title: Hammer: what one blow leaves behind
question: You said the hammer 'mostly makes big strike lines instead of breaking rock into pieces'. Same scene, same swings at the same cliff, one setting changed: how far out from the impact the rock is loosened into pieces (the crack rays are untouched). Which one reads as rock coming apart?
context_md: Counts, since the sheet cannot show them. LEFT-STORED: 3 blows landed, 98 cells broken, 122 cells CRACKED, 44 came off as chunks vs 59 as dust (42% chunk), peak 2 pieces in flight. RIGHT-STORED: 5 blows landed, 321 cells broken, 101 cells CRACKED, 251 as chunks vs 74 as dust (77% chunk), peak 3 pieces in flight. Read the cracked-vs-broken ratio: 1.24 lines per broken cell against 0.31.
